datasets.name: AI4I 2020 Predictive Maintenance (UCI)
datasets.purpose: Synthetic milling-machine failures.
datasets.provenance: UCI ML Repository, documented as synthetic industrial data.
datasets.exclusion_reason: Industrial machine tool, not a road vehicle; its components are not interchangeable with vehicle components.

datasets.name: Auto repair orders, parts and invoices (relational, v1)
datasets.purpose: Workshop repair orders linked to vehicles, parts lines, mechanics and invoices.
datasets.provenance: Customer e-mails use the reserved example.org domain and names are generator output; treated as a synthetic relational sample.
datasets.exclusion_reason: Synthetic sample of 238 orders; its prices and repair patterns are not real workshop evidence, so they are neither indexed as facts nor used for cost estimates.

datasets.name: Automotive fault diagnosis flowcharts (AKTC/oBike et al.)
datasets.purpose: Symptom-to-diagnosis-step decision trees by system (JSON) and rendered flowchart images.
datasets.provenance: Compiled diagnostic flowcharts; source attribution in the file name only.

datasets.name: carOBD Toyota Etios OBD-II telemetry
datasets.purpose: 27 OBD-II PIDs at 1 Hz from one 2014 Toyota Etios (drive/idle/live/long/ufpe logs).
datasets.provenance: github.com/eron93br/carOBD
datasets.license: README asks for citation; no formal licence.

datasets.name: Chinese Vehicle Fleet Fault Association Dataset (CVFFAD)
datasets.purpose: Commercial-fleet fault events, fleet register, knowledge-graph triples and NER annotations (Chinese).
datasets.provenance: Its own records carry source='generated'; the README DOI is a placeholder and the referenced licence file is absent. Root copies are byte-identical to the folder copies.
datasets.license: README claims CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; licence file absent.

datasets.name: Diesel Vehicle OBD-II PID Dataset (ANCEL ELITE 610)
datasets.purpose: OBD-II PID readings from 8 diesel vehicles with the DTCs each vehicle reported.
datasets.provenance: README documents 8 named vehicles; DTC columns are constant per vehicle, so they identify the vehicle rather than a time-varying fault state.
datasets.license: README claims CC BY 4.0; no separate licence file.

datasets.name: DTC diagnostic chat examples (train/validation parquet)
datasets.purpose: Instruction-tuning conversations about DTC codes (system/user/assistant).
datasets.provenance: No source documentation. Assistant answers are templated and contain truncated, unrelated 'technical context' text, so they are not used as reference answers; only user questions are used.

datasets.name: Engine condition sensor tables (raw_data/train/test)
datasets.purpose: Six engine sensor readings with a binary engine_condition label.
datasets.provenance: No source documentation. raw_data.csv is the exact union of train.csv and test.csv.

datasets.name: EngineFaultDB
datasets.purpose: Engine sensor and exhaust-gas readings with numeric fault classes 0-3.
datasets.provenance: Laboratory engine test bench repository.
datasets.exclusion_reason: No acquisition-run identifier, so any split mixes rows from the same run (leakage); the numeric class meanings are not documented locally.

datasets.name: EV Predictive Maintenance Dataset (15-minute)
datasets.purpose: EV battery/motor/brake/tyre signals with failure, RUL and maintenance-type columns.
datasets.provenance: No source documentation. Columns are statistically independent of each other and of the labels (|r| < 0.005, lag-1 autocorrelation 0), which indicates independently generated random values.

datasets.name: Experimental Energy Characterization (NEDC/WLTP)
datasets.purpose: Drive-cycle energy measurements.
datasets.provenance: No accompanying documentation.
datasets.exclusion_reason: No documented vehicle, units, labels or licence; nothing maintenance-related to predict.

datasets.name: Honda (AHM) motorcycle master parts list, Sep 2025 update 19
datasets.purpose: Part number, Indonesian description and supply group for Astra Honda Motor motorcycle parts.
datasets.provenance: Dealer price-list style export; no licence file.

datasets.name: Hyundai component readings (cars_hyundai.csv)
datasets.purpose: Engine temperature, brake pad thickness and tyre pressure with an anomaly flag and maintenance type.
datasets.provenance: No source documentation. Values are uniformly distributed and uncorrelated with the anomaly label.

datasets.name: KIT Automotive OBD-II Dataset (Seat Leon)
datasets.purpose: OBD-II drive logs from one Seat Leon across road types and traffic conditions.
datasets.provenance: doi:10.35097/1130 (KIT); Automotive_Diagnostics-main is a notebook repository bundling the same CSVs.
datasets.exclusion_reason: No fault, repair or maintenance labels; one vehicle. The sensor-anomaly role is already covered by the carOBD pipeline, which has idle/drive baselines.

datasets.name: LEVIN open data (documentation only)
datasets.purpose: Description and notebooks for an external telematics export.
datasets.provenance: Repository without the raw measurement export.
datasets.license: Data CC BY-NC-SA per README; code MIT.
datasets.exclusion_reason: The measurement export itself is not present locally.

datasets.name: Standardized engine/EGR parquet (main_df_standardized)
datasets.purpose: Diesel engine air-path signals with drive_cycle and fault_type columns.
datasets.provenance: No accompanying documentation; values are pre-standardized so physical units are lost.
datasets.exclusion_reason: fault_type values and the standardization reference are undocumented; there is no group identifier for a leakage-free split.

datasets.name: NASA Li-ion Battery Aging Datasets
datasets.purpose: Laboratory 18650 cell charge/discharge/impedance cycling to end of life.
datasets.provenance: NASA Ames Prognostics Center of Excellence.
datasets.license: No licence statement in the local bundle.

datasets.name: Kawasaki Ninja 400 track telemetry (Circuito de Navarra)
datasets.purpose: 95 ECU/datalogger channels from one race-prepared motorcycle, two track days.
datasets.provenance: Depositor README (CC BY 4.0, Electronics 15(12):2604).
datasets.exclusion_reason: Track racing telemetry from one motorcycle with no fault, wear or maintenance label; it cannot be used to infer road-fleet maintenance.

datasets.name: OBDex generic OBD-II DTC and PID reference
datasets.purpose: Generic SAE J2012 DTC titles, descriptions, causes, symptoms and Mode 01/09 PID definitions.
datasets.provenance: github.com/foerbsnavi/obdex

datasets.name: Generated vehicle diagnostic samples (VehicleDiagnosticSample.txt)
datasets.purpose: Prompt/response pairs that begin 'Generate comprehensive vehicle diagnostic ...'.
datasets.provenance: Self-described generator output with random measurements; fault codes are not consistent with the stated systems.
datasets.exclusion_reason: Generated text with random measurements; using it as knowledge would present fabricated diagnostics as reference facts.

datasets.name: Vehicle Maintenance - Service Records (Honda/Toyota, India)
datasets.purpose: Workshop service visits: which of 14 service items were performed at a recorded odometer reading, with visit cost.
datasets.provenance: Public Kaggle-style export; no local source or licence file. Records are internally consistent with manufacturer service schedules (e.g. 60,000 km major service).
datasets.license: Not documented locally; verify before redistribution.
